name: Coupl
subject: Building shared finance at Coupl
body: I've been following how Coupl is reimagining banking for Indian couples, especially around shared expense management. I'm a software engineer, and I built RoundUp (https://github.com/nikhilgobbur3/Roundup-App), an open-source UPI expense tracker that rounds up spare change. Given your focus on joint finances, I'd love to bring my experience with UPI and micro-savings to your engineering team. Are you currently looking for developers who love building in the fintech space?
